Refund Policy

The {{ONBOARDING_FEE}} certificate fee is non-refundable

Version 2026-11 · Last updated November 7, 2026

The ProTech Rise Cohort 2 Tech Bootcamp has a tuition fee of {{TUITION_FEE}}. With our {{SCHOLARSHIP_PERCENT}}% scholarship you pay {{ONBOARDING_FEE}} instead, as a one-time certificate fee. This page explains, in plain terms, what that fee is for and the one case where we refund money.

What the {{ONBOARDING_FEE}} covers

The fee secures your spot in Cohort 2 and covers your certificate, which is issued when you successfully complete the bootcamp. It also pays for setting you up: access to the learning platform, your track and pod allocation, and your place in the community. You pay now; the certificate is issued at the end. Once you pay, we reserve that spot for you and turn away other applicants.

No refunds once paid

The {{ONBOARDING_FEE}} certificate fee is non-refundable once paid. This applies if you:

  • withdraw or change your mind after paying;
  • are unable to attend, or miss the start of the cohort;
  • stop attending or do not complete the programme, in which case no certificate is issued and the fee is not returned.

The one exception: excess payment

If you pay more than the amount due (for example, you are charged twice for the same spot), we refund the excess. We do not refund the amount that was due.

Agreeing to this policy

You are asked to accept this policy before you pay. We record when you accepted it and which version you accepted.

Questions

Email hello@protechrise.com and a person will reply. See also our FAQ and Privacy Policy.
